question: A man sold { {5} over 6} of his articles at a gain of 15% and the remaining at cost price. Find the gain earned by him in the whole transaction.
solution:

Articles sold at 15% profit = 5/6 of the total article

Concept used:

Selling Price = Cost Price + (Cost Price Gain%)

Profit% = {(Selling Price - Cost Price) over Cost Price} × 100\%
